new_source_review_product_negative_candi.observation: VoicePacketCortex accepts packet/event/output monotonic_ms values without enforcing nondecreasing chronology against prior admitted state. advance_output() checks heard_fraction monotonicity but not time monotonicity; accept_input() checks sequence but not clock rollback.
new_source_review_product_negative_candi.risk: A trace can commit an event or output transition at a monotonic timestamp earlier than already admitted causal state, allowing negative derived durations/latencies or chronology claims unless an external caller supplies an unproven fence.

new_source_review_product_negative_candi.observation: close_session() raises VoicePacketCortexError('session is already closed') on a repeated close call and does not retain/return the previously admitted VoiceOutcome as an idempotent replay result.
new_source_review_product_negative_candi.risk: A duplicated/retried close packet cannot be distinguished from a conflicting close and violates the existing F10 close-determinism requirement that duplicate close be idempotent.
